title: CMS Settings
description: Manage CMS configuration, identity, discussion, and performance

analytics.description: Configure how long analytics data should be kept in the database.
analytics.cleanupDescription: Trigger a manual cleanup of old analytics data based on the retention settings. This will permanently delete data older than the specified retention periods.
analytics.cleanupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete old analytics data now?
analytics.purgeConfirm: This permanently deletes every visit, event, and session in analytics (including today). Content page view counters are not changed. Continue?
analytics.purgeSuccess: Removed {count} analytics records. Dashboards will reflect empty data immediately.

descriptions.site_name: The public name of your CMS site
descriptions.site_logo: The main logo of the CMS site
descriptions.site_favicon: The browser icon for your site (recommended 16x16 or 32x32)
descriptions.site_description: A brief description of your site for SEO purposes
descriptions.site_url: The main URL of your CMS application

security.enable_reply: Allow users to reply to other comments
security.allow_guests: Allow users to comment without logging in
security.moderation_enabled: New comments require admin approval before appearing
security.guest_captcha: Require guests to solve a captcha to post
security.max_links: Maximum number of links allowed in a comment (0 for unlimited)
security.banned_words: List of words that will cause a comment to be marked as spam (JSON array)
